title: AI public service profile (local only, never part of export/sync)
$comment: HTTPS, or HTTP only for localhost/127.0.0.1/::1; strip query/fragment, reject URL credentials. Empty path becomes /v1; retain explicit gateway prefixes. Resolve Token only within each service request. POST /chat/completions supports SSE and JSON. GET /models image declarations are yes/no/unknown, never inferred from a model name. Limits: 32768 input characters, 1000000 output characters, 4 concurrent requests.
